overall_assessment: The 20 plans retain substantive prerequisites and the structured course-specific outcome lists, with recurring PDF extraction errors in placement arrangements, statements of purpose and page footers. Five plans keep an embedded coursework approval condition in assessment, and both assessment flags on BSYP-503 identify a programme appendix merged into that row. VIB-101's empty flag is a false alarm from the 15-character threshold because Praksisstudier names the requirement under Arbeidskrav.

findings.evidence:
Praksisstudier med godkjent arbeidskrav vurderes til bestått/ikke bestått.
Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter
findings.description: The long and leak->learning_outcomes flags both identify the same boundary error. A one-sentence assessment runs into the national programme-level learning outcomes appendix, producing a 10,537-character assessment row. The course-specific outcomes appear under their own heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The LDH text fallback in R/blocks.R recognizes exact configured headings. Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter has no drop boundary in the LDH heading map.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize Studiets overordnede læringsutbytter as an exact LDH text boundary mapped to .drop. Stop the open assessment block at that heading and omit the programme appendix from the canonical sections.

findings.evidence:
Emnet omfatter praksisforberedende studier (prekliniske og/eller postkliniske), hvorav
normalt 8 uker (240 timer) er tilstedeværelse i klinisk kontekst.
findings.description: Seven placement plans report preparatory studies and the duration of clinical attendance exclusively in course_content and emit no teaching_methods row. These arrangements describe how students work. The surrounding clauses describe the clinical subject matter.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The text fallback assigns the whole Innhold block to course_content. The LDH clinical placement template combines teaching arrangements and subject matter in the same paragraph.
findings.suggested_fix: In the LDH PDF path, split the stock lead-in beginning Emnet omfatter praksisforberedende studier at the end of the clinical attendance clause. Move the verbatim lead-in to teaching_methods, accepting 8 and åtte and the observed PDF wrapping and spelling variants. Retain the clinical topic clauses in course_content.

findings.evidence: Praksisstudier med godkjent arbeidskrav vurderes til bestått/ikke bestått.
findings.description: Five placement offerings keep an approved-work requirement solely inside the assessment sentence. The same sentence states the pass/fail grade for placement. Controls with a separate sentence requiring an approved seminar presentation already extract that sentence into coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R splits standalone gate sentences. The LDH placement template embeds the gate in the subject of a single grading sentence, with no standalone condition for the matcher to move.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an anchored LDH rule for Praksisstudier med godkjent arbeidskrav vurderes til bestått/ikke bestått. Extract the exact requirement phrase into coursework_requirements and retain the placement and grade wording in assessment.

findings.evidence:
Videre skal studenten
kunne planlegge og igangsette sykepleietiltak og begrunne disse.
findings.description: Many PDF plans retain explicit student capabilities in course_content because they are written under Hensikt or Formål. For example, the goal of planning, initiating and justifying nursing measures is stated in course_content of BSY-202 and absent from its extracted list of outcomes.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading-based routing treats an entire Hensikt or Formål block as course_content even where that block contains both a topic summary and standalone capability statements.
findings.suggested_fix: For LDH purpose blocks, match complete sentences with explicit student-capability leads such as Videre skal studenten kunne and Studenten skal kunne, including across PDF line wraps. Route those sentences to learning_outcomes and retain the topic sentences in course_content.

findings.evidence:
Studenten skal gjennomføre minimum 10 systematiske helhetsundersøkelser på eget
       arbeidssted, under veiledning av arbeidsstedets lege eller en avansert klinisk
findings.description: The teaching_methods row carries the required minimum of ten examinations and the conditions for completing them. The coursework_requirements row says students must document the same examinations before sitting the exam, so the obligation is already identified as a gate, with its site and supervision details filed elsewhere.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R considers sentences in teaching_methods individually. The teaching sentence contains no exam-gate marker, and the later coursework sentence supplies the link.
findings.suggested_fix: For this LDH template, when coursework_requirements explicitly requires documentation of ten systematiske helhetsundersøkelser to sit the exam, move the matching numeric minimum sentence from teaching_methods to coursework_requirements with its site and supervision details.

findings.evidence: Master i klinisk intensivsykepleie. Sist oppdatert
findings.description: Five postgraduate or continuing-education plans retain repeated PDF programme footers and, in several cases, adjacent page numbers in course content, outcomes or teaching methods. Page furniture interrupts sentences and lists. The knowledge, skills and general competence groups survive.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The LDH PDF fallback appends unrecognized page furniture to the active text block.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip complete LDH PDF footer lines matching the Master i or Videreutdanning i programme name plus Sist oppdatert, along with numeric-only page lines adjacent to those footers, before sectionization.

findings.evidence:
I emnet inngår nasjonal
deleksamen i anatomi, fysiologi og biokjemi.
findings.description: A sentence announcing a national exam component remains in course_content. The assessment row already carries the same exam component with its form, scale and credit value.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The mixed Innhold block is routed to course_content, and the existing assessment-design relocation in R/extract_sections.R only checks teaching_methods.
findings.suggested_fix: Within LDH course content, suppress the standalone I emnet inngår nasjonal deleksamen announcement when the extracted assessment already contains the same named exam. Keep the topic description and assessment details.
